scripts.install:all: npm run install:orchestrator && npm run install:mcp && npm run install:web && npm run install:desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/orchestrator && npm run build --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run build --prefix packages/web
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix packages/orchestrator && npm run check --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run check --prefix packages/web && npm run check:rust
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/council-core/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/council-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/orchestrator && npm test --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm test --prefix packages/web && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path crates/council-core/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path packages/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix packages/orchestrator --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix packages/mcp-server --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix packages/web --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix packages/desktop --audit-level=high
